```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(readr)
library(vip)
library(janitor)
library(forcats)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(readxl)
library(broom)
library(ggfortify)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(skimr)
library(rsample)
library(themis)
library(yardstick)
library(xgboost)
library(bslib)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shinythemes)
library(knitr)
library(stringr)

# Import data
dataRaw <- read_csv("healthcare.csv")
dataClean <- dataRaw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    ever_married    = if_else(ever_married == "Yes", 1L, 0L),
    residence_type  = if_else(residence_type == "Urban", 1L, 0L),
    gender          = if_else(gender == "Male", 1L, 0L),
    stroke          = factor(stroke, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    work_type       = as.factor(work_type),
    smoking_status  = as.factor(smoking_status),
    bmi             = as.numeric(na_if(bmi, "N/A"))
  )

dataClean2 <- dataClean %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(smoking_status != "Unknown")
```

===========================================================

##### Predictor's Summary:

```{r side_bar}
selectInput("hist_var", "Select a variable:", 
  choices = c("Age" = "age", "BMI" = "bmi", "Glucose Level" = "avg_glucose_level",
              "Heart Disease" = "heart_disease", "Hypertension" = "hypertension"))
```

#### Prediction:
```{r side_bar2}
sliderInput("age", "Age:", min = 0, max = 100, value = 50)

selectInput("gender", "Gender:", choices = c("Male" = 1, "Female" = 0))

selectInput("smoking", "Smoking Status:", 
            choices = levels(dataClean$smoking_status))

selectInput("work", "Work Type:", choices = levels(dataClean$work_type))

selectInput("residence", "Residence Type:", choices = c("Urban" = 1, "Rural" = 0))

sliderInput("bmi", "BMI:", min = 10, max = 60, value = 25)

checkboxInput("married", "Ever Married?", TRUE)

actionButton("predict", "Predict Stroke Risk")
```

### Data Dictionary for Selected Variables

```{r Dictionary, echo=FALSE}
data.frame(
  Variables = c("id","gender", "age", "hypertension", "heart_disease", 
                "ever_married", "work_type", "residence_type", 
                "avg_glucose_level", "bmi", "smoking_status", "stroke"),
  Description = c("Unique Identifier",
                  "Binary variable: 0 = Female, 1 = Male", 
                  "Continuous variable — patient’s age in years", 
                  "Binary variable: 0 = No hypertension, 1 = Yes",
                  "Binary variable: 0 = No history of heart disease, 1 = Yes",
                  "Binary variable: 0 = Never married, 1 = Ever married",
                  "Categorical: types of employment (Private, Govt job, etc.)",
                  "Binary: 0 = Rural, 1 = Urban",
                  "Continuous variable — average blood glucose level (mg/dL)",
                  "Continuous variable — Body Mass Index", 
                  "Categorical: never smoked, formerly smoked, smokes",
                  "Whether the patient has had a stroke (Yes or No)"),
  Type = c("Identifier", "Predictor", "Predictor", "Predictor", 
           "Predictor", "Predictor", "Predictor", "Predictor", 
           "Predictor", "Predictor", "Predictor", "Outcome")
) %>% 
  kable()
```

### Interactive Histogram

```{r}
plotlyOutput("hist_plot")
```

```{r}
output$hist_plot <- renderPlotly({
  req(input$hist_var)

  p <- ggplot(dataClean2, aes(x = .data[[input$hist_var]])) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 30,
      fill = "darkred",
      color = "#101010",
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 12), labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", input$hist_var))),
      x = str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", input$hist_var)),
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16, color = "white"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, color = "white"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "white"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010", color = NA)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("x", "y"))
})
```
